ria: Heads-up I opened a PR to adjust the model catalog entry for sylph-lite3 — small changes: clarify supported sequence range, add variant pinning guidance, and include a compact JS + Python snippet showing variant selection + fallback. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1109
 tom: Thanks. What's the recommended batch window for long context?
 ria: Runtime recommends 40ms for sequences >4096 on A100. Added that in the limits table.
 anya: Please add a one-line cold-start note for the int4 quant fallback (~1.4x cold-start latency). Also request from Console: a YAML flag so UI can surface fallback info.
 ria: Added `variants:
  - name: sylph-lite3-fp32
  - name: sylph-lite3-int4
    fallback: true` to the model YAML and a migration note: "Pin the variant (e.g., sylph-lite3-fp32) to avoid latency variance."
 docs-ci-bot: linkcheck failed  on bench anchor /bench#sylph-lite3 (missing).
 tom: I'll add the anchor header to the bench page and push a tiny fix.
 docs-ci-bot: all checks green on PR 1109 (linkcheck, linter).
 anya: Could we add p50/p95 numbers (one-line) for sales? Small blurb was added: p50=48ms, p95=132ms (internal bench link).
 ria: Merging after CI. Filed internal note for Support: https://intranet.redwood.ai/notes/sylph-lite3-fallback
